**Continuous 2.38.1**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.38.0, 2.36.0, 2.34.0, 2.32.0, 2.30.0, 2.28.0, 2.26.0, 2.24.0, 2.22.0, 2.20.0, 2.18.0, 2.16.3, 2.16.2, 2.16.1, 2.16.0, 2.14.0, 2.12.x, 2.10.x or 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.38.1.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                       |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.38.1.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.38.1.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.38.1.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.38.1.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.38.1.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.38.1.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.38.1-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.38.1.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.38.1-vscode/continuous-cli-2.38.1.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). The short command `cn` also works; both run the same program. It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.38.0

A turn that finishes with no answer and no tool call says so. Reasoning from that turn stays in the thinking block and is not treated as the reply. The chat diagnostic log is included.

No new host is contacted by the extension or the terminal agent.

### New

- **Diagnostic log.** A button under the chat input opens a log that is closed by default. It keeps the latest 80 events in the webview and does not write them into the session: an empty stop, a context-window refusal, a tool error, a compile or prune, and a provider error.
- **Long chats.** Rows far from the viewport are not rendered. The conversation stays in the session and on disk; scrolling back mounts those rows again.

### Fixes

- **Empty stop.** When the model finishes with reasoning and neither an answer nor a tool call, the chat says the turn stopped without a reply. When the stop is the output limit, the message names that cap and the context window in use.
- **Claude output cap.** A request whose output cap is not above the thinking budget is raised by 4096 tokens, so Claude accepts the call. A cap that already has room is left as it is.
